log_content_placeholder = "RAW LOG CONTENT FOR 489 WILL BE INSERTED HERE"

output_path = "storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/all_transgen_logs.jsonl"

data = {
    "eval_id": eval_id_to_process,
    "log_content": log_content_placeholder
}

# Using 'a' to append, creating the file if it doesn't exist.
with open(output_path, 'a') as f:
    f.write(json.dumps(data) + '\\n')
    
print(f"Placeholder for Eval ID {eval_id_to_process} written to {output_path}. Will replace with real data next.")
